identity.title: Market Truth / Realtime Data Plane
identity.objective: Implement a durable public market-truth plane with native Polymarket Market WebSocket ingestion, reconnect/gap/resnapshot semantics, raw and normalized bounded SQLite evidence, public Data/Gamma/CLOB GET collection, public Polygon V2 OrderFilled log decoding with confirmation/reorg handling, point-in-time dynamic configuration and resolution material, existing canonical PIT handoff, and a manually started explicitly stoppable runtime. Add exactly websockets==17.1. No credentials, authenticated/private access, signing, orders, OMS, strategy, paper/live trading, Hermes runtime, dashboard, service scheduler, server database, message bus, cloud infrastructure, or WP170 implementation.
identity.xl_authorization_basis: The user's Side 8 execution brief explicitly authorizes XL up to the schema maximum. The exact 35-file scope is one coherent public market-truth capability: six narrow source modules, one explicit CLI, focused tests, one contract, exact dependency/CI registration, security/adoption evidence, status/roadmap consequences, four mechanically required full-diff compatibility guards, and the immutable package. It uses the 35-path maximum and grants no merge or trading authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert the WP169 branch. The committed change adds a public-data acquisition package, one explicit manual CLI, exact websockets dependency/CI coverage, focused tests, contract/package evidence, four mechanical compatibility guard edits, and repo-truth consequences. Generated acquisition SQLite databases remain ignored and outside canonical PIT authority. No migration, credential, account state, order, OMS, strategy, paper/live, execution, risk, Hermes, dashboard, service, or cloud state is created.

api_matrix.reason: WP169 adds a net-new public acquisition surface and does not change a predecessor public signature. The exact new API is frozen in the prompt and public_market_truth_realtime_data_plane_contract; existing PIT, analytical, and replay APIs remain unchanged.

semantic_fields.reason: The public truth plane has bounded raw, normalized, gap, RPC, PIT-promotion, network-authority, and runtime-lifecycle semantics that the normative matrix and focused tests bind.
